prompts: Use case: ads-marketing. Create ONE finished 4:3 landscape XcellHost promotional banner for SMB Cloud Desktop, matching the attached reference image's branding, composition, materials, colors and polished photographic/3D treatment. Reference image role: style and brand reference only; create a new desktop computing scene, not a video conference scene. Upper left: retain the XcellHost logo and the small tagline 'Cloud ▪ Security ▪ Growth' from the reference. Left side on white: large bold readable headline 'SMB' in dark navy, then 'Cloud Desktop' in vivid royal blue; a smaller dark gray subtitle 'Your business desktop, securely available anywhere.' Right side: a luminous cyan cloud connected to a laptop, a desktop monitor and a tablet showing clean generic desktop workspaces, with modern blue server racks and glass office buildings beneath, in a bright modern data center. Bottom: a rounded pale blue panel with blue 'Get Started →' button on the left and four clear colorful pictograms with short labels 'Desktop Anywhere', 'Secure Access', 'Team Collaboration', 'Cloud Backup'. Match the reference typography and balanced layout. Keep every element and all text inside generous safe margins. Crisp sharp detailed output, no blur, no watermark, no extra headings or additional panels. Deliver a single complete banner, not a collage or mockup.
